examName: Lecturer (Electronics) Maharashtra Education Service, Group-B (Collegiate Branch) Higher and Technical Education Department - Syllabus
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Energy bands in solids, concept of effective mass, density of states, Fermi levels

Classification: conductors, semiconductors, insulators; intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors, PN Junction, Forward and reverse biasing of p-n junction, Diode equation and diode equivalent circuit, Breakdown in diodes
Types of Diodes: Zener diode, Tunnel diode
Metal semiconductor junction: Ohmic and Schottky contacts
Bipolar Junction Transistors (BJT): NPN and PNP transistors, working principle, Transistor Output characteristics and various regions of operation
UJT, JFET, MOSFET: Structure, Working Principles, and Output Characteristics
High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT): Working Principle
Optoelectronic devices: LED, Photodiode, Phototransistor, Solar cells: I-V characteristics, fill factor and efficiency
LED, LCD and flexible display devices
Rectifiers: Half-wave, full-wave, Bridge and related parameters
Voltage regulated Power Supply, Voltage Regulator ICs
BJT biasing: Biasing of Bipolar junction, DC and AC Load line, Operating point and stability, BJT as amplifier and as a switch

BJT as amplifiers: Configurations: C-B, C-C, C-E, Different Biasing methods of C-E amplifier: Base bias, collector feedback bias and voltage divider, Design of Single stage and Multistage C-E amplifiers
Classification of BJT Amplifiers: Class A, B, AB and C
Oscillators: Concept of feedback: positive and negative feedback, Barkhausen criteria
Type of oscillators: Wein bridge, Hartley, Colpitt's and Phase Shift oscillators
Operational amplifiers (OPAMP): Ideal and Practical parameter values of OPAMP, Block diagram of OPAMP, Differential amplifier
Configurations of OPAMP: Inverting and Non-inverting amplifier

Applications of OPAMP: Voltage follower, Adder, Subtractor, Integrator, Differentiator, Comparator, Schmitt Trigger, Instrumentation amplifiers, Wave shaping circuits, Phase locked loops, Active filters, Multivibrators, Voltage to frequency convertors (V/F), frequency to voltage convertors (F/V)
Number systems: Decimal, binary, hexadecimal and their interconversions, BCD code, ASCII and EBCDIC codes, 1's & 2's complement subtraction methods
Logic Gates: basic, derived, universal gates; Boolean algebra, De Morgan's theorems, minimization techniques (K maps), SOP and POS form of Boolean equations
Combinational Logic Circuits: Half-adder, Full adder, Multiplexers and Demultiplexers, Encoders, Decoders
Sequential Circuits: Flip-flops, Memories, Counters: Ring, Ripple, Synchronous, Asynchronous; Shift registers, Programmable Logic Devices (PLD), CPLD, Sequential PLD, FPGA, A/D and D/A converters
Digital Circuit Design: Analysis and Design of fundamental mode state machines: State variables, State table and State diagram, Design and Analysis of digital circuits using HDL
Logic Families: Bipolar and unipolar families, TTL and CMOS circuits and its characteristics
IC fabrication: crystal growth, epitaxy, oxidation, lithography, doping, etching, isolation methods, metallization, bonding

Thin film deposition, characterization Techniques: XRD, TEM, SEM, EDX; Thin film active and passive devices, MOS technology and VLSI, scaling of MOS devices, NMOS and CMOS structures and fabrication, Characteristics of MOS transistors and threshold voltage, NMOS and CMOS inverters
Charge-Coupled Device (CCD): structure, charge storage and transfer
Basics of VLSI design, stick diagrams, Layout design rules
Concept of voltage source and current source, impedance of the source and its significance
Network Theorems: Thevenin, Norton, Superposition and Maximum Power Transfer Theorems, Network elements, Network graphs, Nodal and Mesh analysis

Laplace Transform, Fourier Transform and Z-transform. Time and frequency domain response, Passive filters and Two-port Network Parameters: Z, Y, ABCD and h parameters, Transfer functions, Signal representation, State variable method of circuit analysis, AC circuit analysis, Transient analysis, Zero and Poles, Bode Plots

Continuous time signals, Fourier Series and Fourier transform representations, Sampling theorem and applications, Discrete time signal, Discrete Fourier transform (DFT), Fast Fourier transform (FFT), Basic concepts of digital signal processing, digital filters - IIR, FIR

Introduction of Microcontrollers: 8051 for embedded systems, Architecture and register set of Microcontroller 8051; Addressing modes, Instruction set of 8051: Data transfer instructions, Arithmetic instructions, Logic instructions, bit level and byte level control transfer instructions
8051 assembly programming: stack operations, subroutines, interrupts, 8051 programming as timer/counter, 8051 serial communication, 8051 interfacing RS232, LED/LCD display, Keyboard, Stepper motor
Introduction to Embedded Systems: Definition, Components, Block diagram, Working flow, Characteristics, Classification, Modern trends and Applications, Introduction to Embedded C programming
Electrostatics: vector calculus, Gauss's Law, Laplace and Poisson's equations, Magnetostatics: Biot Savart's law, Ampere's law

Electromagnetic induction, Maxwell's equations and wave equations, Plane wave propagation in free space, dielectrics and conductors, Poynting theorem, Reflection and refraction, polarization, interference, coherence and diffraction
Transmission lines and waveguides: line equations, impedance, reflections and voltage standing wave ratio, rectangular waveguides
Antennas: retarded potential and Hertzian dipole, half wave antenna, antenna patterns, radiation intensity, gain, effective area and Friis' free space receiver power equation
Microwave Sources and Devices: Reflex Klystron, Magnetron, TWT, Gunn diode, IMPATT diode, Crystal Detector and PIN diode
Radar: block diagram of Radar, frequencies and power used, Radar range equation
Elements of communication system, types of communication, frequency spectrum
Need of modulation, Analog modulation and demodulation: AM, FM, PAM, PWM, PPM
Principle of super heterodyne receiver, Random signals, noise, noise temperature and noise figure, Basic concepts of information theory, Error detection and correction
Digital modulation and demodulation: PCM, ASK, FSK, PSK, BPSK, QPSK and QAM; Time and Frequency-Division Multiplexing, Multiple Access techniques
Data Communications: Modems, Codes, Principles of Mobile and Satellite Communication, Optical communication
Optical sources: LED, spontaneous and stimulated emission, semiconductor Lasers; Detectors: PIN photodiodes, Avalanche photodiodes (APD)
Optical fibers: attenuation and dispersion characteristics, Bandwidth, Wavelength division multiplexing
Fundamentals of Internet of Things (IoT), IoT protocols used for communication

Power devices and systems: characteristics of SCR, DIAC, TRIAC, power transistors, Protection of thyristors against over voltage and over current, SCR triggering - dv/dt and di/dt, triggering with single pulse and train of pulses, A.C. and D.C. motors - construction and speed control
Switch Mode Power Supply (SMPS), Uninterrupted Power Supply (UPS)

Control Systems: Open loop and closed loop control system, Block Diagram reduction techniques, transfer function and signal flow diagram, Stability criterion: Routh-Hurwitz and Nyquist plot, On-off controller, Proportional (P), Proportional-Integral (PI), Proportional-Derivative (PD), PID controllers
Programmable Logic Controller: Block diagram, Basics of Ladder Programming
Sensors and transducers: Classification, selection criteria
Measurement of physical parameters: temperature, displacement, velocity, acceleration, force, torque, strain, magnetic field, flow, high pressure, low pressure, humidity
Signal conditioning circuits: Differential amplifier, instrumentation amplifier
Sensors for IoT applications
Equipment for measurement of R, L and C, voltage, current, power, energy, frequency/time, phase, Digital Multimeters
CRO: Block diagram, working of CRO, front panel controls, Digital Storage Oscilloscope
Function generator: block diagram and working, Spectrum Analyzer
Biomedical Instruments: ECG, EEG, Blood Pressure Measurements
MEMS and its applications
